items.title: Denzel Boston: Ineffective playing through toe injury
items.text:
Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tank Dell: Three receptions in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Dell brought in three of four targets for 21 yards and rushed once for no gain in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Xavier Hutchinson: Records TD grab in loss
items.text:
Hutchinson brought in four of nine targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Limping following loss Sunday
items.text:
Brown (hamstring) was spotted limping out of the locker room following Sunday's Week 10 loss to Detroit, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Gets nine touches to Hall's 15
items.text:
Allen rushed eight times for 40 yards and caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
